narrative.overview: Classora is a Vietnamese-first workspace for running a training center's day. It uses a light application shell, white operational surfaces, blue interactions, green success states, and dense readable data.
keyCharacteristics: Light authenticated frame with persistent tenant identity
Blue primary actions and navigation emphasis
Green reserved for positive operational states
Cool-gray workspace with grouped white surfaces
Compact Vietnamese-first typography and dense readable tables

rules.name: Operational Honesty
rules.body: Every surface, metric, and control must support real center operations and real data.

rules.name: Semantic Color
rules.body: Blue owns interaction and focus; green owns active and successful states.

rules.name: Compact Clarity
rules.body: Use grouped information and dense tables without oversized cards or ornamental hierarchy.

dos: Do keep the current center identity visible in the authenticated shell.
Do use meaningful grouping for operational details and forms.
Do preserve semantic tables, labels, focus states, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add metrics, charts, global search, notifications, or future navigation without working product behavior.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, oversized cards, or heavy shadows.
Don't introduce another component library or a generic page factory.
